# sfcompute_skus (Data Source)

Reads skus from SF Compute (`GET /v2/skus`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sfcompute_skus" "all" {}

output "h100_skus" {
  value = [for s in data.sfcompute_skus.all.data : s.id if try(s.accelerator.value, "") == "H100"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ending_before` (String) Cursor for backward pagination.
- `include_deleted` (Boolean) Include retired (soft-deleted) SKUs in the results. Defaults to false.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of results to return (1-200, default 50).
- `starting_after` (String) Cursor for forward pagination (from a previous response's `cursor` field).

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String) Pass as `starting_after` or `ending_before` to paginate.
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `accelerator` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--accelerator))
- `alias` (String) A short, unique among live, human-recognizable name for this SKU, e.g. `richmond`. For display only - reference the SKU by `id`.
- `availability_zone` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--availability_zone))
- `deleted_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `form_factor` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--form_factor))
- `id` (String)
- `infiniband_fabric` (String) InfiniBand fabric this SKU's instances attach to. An instance can join an InfiniBand partition only if the partition is on this fabric, so pass it as `fabric` when creating one. Absent when the SKU has no InfiniBand fabric.
- `local_storage_bytes` (Attributes) Total local storage in bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--local_storage_bytes))
- `memory_bytes` (Attributes) Total system memory in bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--memory_bytes))
- `num_accelerators` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--num_accelerators))
- `num_vcpus` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--num_vcpus))
- `rdma_type` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--rdma_type))
- `region` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--region))
- `supports_public_ipv4` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--supports_public_ipv4))
